scripts.db:migrate: npm run db:build && node packages/db-tools/dist/cli.js migrate up --dir apps/api
scripts.db:migrate:status: npm run db:build && node packages/db-tools/dist/cli.js migrate status --dir apps/api
scripts.db:migrate:down: npm run db:build && node packages/db-tools/dist/cli.js migrate down --dir apps/api
scripts.db:reset: npm run db:build && node packages/db-tools/dist/cli.js reset --dir apps/api
scripts.db:seed: npm run db:build && node packages/db-tools/dist/cli.js seed --dir apps/api
scripts.db:seed:list: npm run db:build && node packages/db-tools/dist/cli.js seed --list --dir apps/api
